meaning:
εὐσεβής, -ές
(εὖ, σέβομαι), [in LXX: Pro.12:12, Isa.24:16 26:7 (צַדִּיק), Mic.7:2 (חָסִיד), Isa.32:8 (נָדִיב), and frequently in Sirach and 4Maccabees ;]
pious, godly, devout: Act.10:2, 7, 2Pe.2:9.†
SYN.: θεοσεβής, θρῆσκος (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii; DB, ii, 221 f.; Cremer, 524 f., 858) (AS)

elsewhere.note: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
